$comment: HEALTH_STATISTICS production infrastructure sequence (items 38-44). NONE of these has been run. Every mutating step needs its own explicit owner approval; approval for one step never covers the next.
stop_rules: first failure or unexpected output stops the sequence; no blind retry
never print, persist or commit a token or a database id outside the git-ignored local config
never push or merge from this sequence
the content database is only ever READ (fingerprint, absence queries)

commands.purpose: read-only preflight: account, existing databases, content DB baseline
commands.command: npx wrangler whoami; npx wrangler d1 list --json; npx wrangler d1 execute global-content-os --remote --json --command "SELECT type, name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' AND name NOT LIKE '_cf_%' AND name <> 'd1_migrations' ORDER BY type, name" | node scripts/statistics-schema-fingerprint.mjs
commands.expected: the expected account; exactly the known databases and NO database named global-content-os-stats; the content DB fingerprint is recorded as the BEFORE baseline

commands.command: npx wrangler d1 create global-content-os-stats   (no --location: automatic placement; the owner may add one explicit location hint, it does not change the contract)
commands.expected: prints a new database_id (a UUID that differs from the content database id c0ce92dc-9842-4dd9-9d05-a8d09e798b34); the database is empty; it is created in the same account as the Worker
commands.rollback: leave it UNBOUND and EMPTY (nothing references it). Deleting it needs a separate explicit approval OWNER_APPROVAL_DELETE_EMPTY_STATS_DB; it is never deleted automatically

commands.purpose: write the local stats-only migration config (never committed) and record the Time Travel baseline
commands.command: copy release/wrangler.stats-migrate.template.toml to release/wrangler.stats-migrate.toml and replace the database_id with the value printed by I1; npx wrangler d1 time-travel info STATS_DB --config release/wrangler.stats-migrate.toml
commands.expected: the config names ONLY STATS_DB with migrations_dir migrations/statistics; no content database entry; the real id exists only in the git-ignored copy

commands.purpose: apply statistics migration 0001 to the new STATS_DB only
commands.command: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply STATS_DB --remote --config release/wrangler.stats-migrate.toml   (pinned: migrations/statistics/0001_statistics_schema_v1.sql sha256 c8fd565ff49b324c4712784f3018564eee875d42e53321cff2b1e678ed5c6339)
commands.rollback: the database holds no data yet: record the Time Travel bookmark before; if a later gate fails, leave the database unbound; a reset (delete + create) needs separate explicit approvals

commands.purpose: post-migration verification: schema fingerprint equals the frozen one and the content database is unchanged
commands.command: npx wrangler d1 execute STATS_DB --remote --config release/wrangler.stats-migrate.toml --json --command "<FINGERPRINT_QUERY>" | node scripts/statistics-schema-fingerprint.mjs ; the same fingerprint script against the content DB (as in I0)
commands.expected: STATS_DB fingerprint sha256 3497b347f506ba0db08c2bd43ffa2181e2d41563a42ad559666c3f48f6d2ffe4 with counts {index 27, table 18, trigger 49, view 1}; the content DB fingerprint equals the I0 baseline; no statistics object in the content DB

commands.purpose: registry bootstrap: 32 source IDENTITY rows, no policy rows, all DISABLED
commands.command: npx wrangler d1 execute STATS_DB --remote --config release/wrangler.stats-migrate.toml --file release/statistics-registry-bootstrap.sql   (generated; check with node scripts/statistics-build-bootstrap-sql.mjs --check)
commands.expected: 32 inserts; idempotent (INSERT OR IGNORE); no ACTIVE or ACTIVATION_GATED value anywhere in the file
commands.rollback: identity rows are retire-only (no delete); nothing is active, so nothing needs undoing

commands.purpose: verify the source default is DISABLED everywhere and nothing has run
commands.command: npx wrangler d1 execute STATS_DB --remote --config release/wrangler.stats-migrate.toml --json --command "<Q_ALL_SOURCES_DEFAULT_DISABLED; Q_NOT_DISABLED; Q_NO_RUNS_NO_DATA>"
commands.expected: every source has no policy row (DISABLED by the frozen default); 0 ACTIVE/ACTIVATION_GATED/PAUSED; 0 runs, 0 versions, 0 current rows, 0 releases

commands.purpose: STATS_DB binding + disabled canary switch + dormant routes: apply the reviewed patch with the real id and deploy
commands.command: git apply release/statistics-binding.patch; replace REPLACE_WITH_DATABASE_ID_FROM_CREATE with the I1 id in wrangler.toml; then the repository release flow (npm run release:preflight, npm run release:gate, deploy) with STATISTICS_CANARY_ENABLED = "false"
commands.expected: the deployed Worker has bindings DB, AI, ASSETS, STATS_DB; STATISTICS_CANARY_ENABLED is "false"; content routes unchanged; /api/ready READY
commands.rollback: redeploy the previous Worker version recorded at preflight (read live, not assumed); STATS_DB stays empty and unreferenced

commands.purpose: production runtime validation after the binding (no run starts)
commands.command: node scripts/statistics-canary-operator.mjs --url <worker> status   (OPS_TOKEN from the environment only; this sequence neither creates nor rotates it) ; GET /api/statistics/ops/summary ; GET /api/statistics/ops/contract
commands.expected: STATS_DB visible and schema applied; policy DISABLED; sources 32; runs 0; active policies 0; enabled false; the contract route lists the nine owner gates and scheduler default OFF

commands.purpose: final isolation and default re-verification before any canary step
commands.command: repeat the I4 content-database fingerprint and Q_STATS_OBJECTS_ABSENT_IN_CONTENT_DB; repeat I6
commands.expected: content DB fingerprint equals the I0 baseline; 0 statistics objects in the content DB; every source DISABLED; 0 runs
